text.p: Feuding petroleum explorers Anzoil NL and Frontier Petroleum NL said on Thursday they had reached agreement for Anzoil to acquire Frontier's disputed stake in Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd.
As a result of the agreement, Anzoil will own 100 percent of Anzoil (Asia) and all litigation between Anzoil and Frontier will be terminated, they said in a joint statement.
Anzoil (Asia) is the holder of their interest in the onshore Hanoi Basin Production Sharing Contract (PSC) in Vietnam.

Anzoil will acquire Frontier's interest in Anzoil (Asia) by the issue of 55 million ordinary shares, representing about 7.5 percent of its issued capital, to Frontier and for Anzoil's holding of 12.42 million ordinary shares in Frontier to be cancelled, they said.
The agreement is subject to the approval of Frontier shareholders.
"Anzoil and Frontier believe that this agreement will allow Anzoil as operator to pursue the potential of the Hanoi Basin PSC in the most efficient manner," they said.
Frontier remains committed to development of the Hanoi Basin through its shareholding in Anzoil, they said.
Their dispute was over how much Frontier's stake in Anzoil (Asia) had been diluted by its failure to meet funding obligations in the Hanoi Basin PSC.
Their original holdings were Anzoil 80 percent and Frontier 20 percent.
Anzoil (Asia) has had several gas finds in the PSC.
